title: Sources: UK-based cloud provider Nscale is in talks to raise about $2B, after raising more than $1.5B across a pair of rounds in September and October (Bailey Lipschultz/Bloomberg)
summary: Bailey Lipschultz / Bloomberg: Sources: UK-based cloud provider Nscale is in talks to raise about $2B, after raising more than $1.5B across a pair of rounds in September and October — Data center company Nscale is in talks with investors to raise about $2 billion, according to people familiar with the matter …
